verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm a live llms.txt at docs.adyen.com, which returns HTTP 200 and describes Adyen's developer and merchant docs. They also confirm agent-friendly Markdown versions of the Agentic Commerce pages (.md URLs with YAML front matter), so an agent can be pointed directly at machine-readable docs. missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the llms.txt/Markdown docs offering and how to use it with agents, verification that llms.txt indexes the Agentic Commerce section specifically.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
